select_closest_cond_frames: select up to N conditioning frames temporally closest to a given frame index from a dictionary of frame outputs
get_1d_sine_pe: compute 1D sine positional embeddings for a tensor of position indices with configurable dimension and temperature
sample_box_points: sample noised top-left and bottom-right corner coordinates from binary mask tensors with configurable noise fraction and bounds
sample_random_points_from_errors: sample random points with positive or negative labels from false positive and false negative error regions between ground truth and predicted masks
sample_one_point_from_error_center: sample one point from the center of the largest error region using OpenCV distance transform for interactive segmentation refinement
